event.title: PCN-101 (arketamine) development is discontinued
event.proposition: The sponsor of PCN-101 (arketamine) announces that clinical development of the program is discontinued.
event.criterion: TRUE on the date of the first definitive public statement by the sponsor of PCN-101 (atai Life Sciences, its subsidiary Perception Neuroscience, or a successor owner or licensee of the asset), in a press release, SEC filing or investor presentation, that development of PCN-101 (arketamine, R-ketamine) is discontinued or terminated, or that the program has been removed from the pipeline with no further development planned. A missed endpoint, a pause pending data, a search for a partner, or a deprioritization that keeps the program under evaluation is not discontinuation. Development that continues under a licensee or new owner of the asset is not discontinuation. Resolution source: atai Life Sciences press releases and SEC filings (EDGAR).

resolution_source.name: atai Life Sciences press releases and SEC filings (EDGAR)

readings: 'The arketamine story is over' is read as the sponsor discontinuing the PCN-101 (arketamine) program, the only arketamine program in the post. The forecaster says this is unlikely.
The event is written on the asset, so it follows PCN-101 through a rename, a partnership or a sale; continued development by a licensee or new owner keeps the event FALSE.
